correctness.rationale: For every n>=3, closed length-n walks in the explicit period-five temporal history graph biject with Fix(F_n^5); since 5 is prime, subtract Fix(F_n) and divide by 5. Its single 49-vertex recurrent component and the exact 49-degree determinant are reconstructed from the original local truth table via exact Newton-trace identities, not finite length interpolation. Direct enumeration independently verifies all exceptions through n=17. Primitive five-cycle seeds at n=11 and n=12 share a stationary history pair 10 admitting length 3 and 4 return loops; insertion constructs all n>=14. Strong connectivity and coprime cycles prove Perron asymptotics, and strict growth comparison uses integer positive vector inequalities.
